name: Sun Sentinel
body:
Sun Sentinel
CR 10

XP 9,600
N Large plant (fire)
Init +6; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +22
Aura fiery aura

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 12, flat-footed 21 (–1 size, +2 Dex, +1 dodge, +12 natural)
hp 127 (15d8+60)
Fort +13, Ref +9, Will +10
Defensive Traits solar adaptation; DR 10/magic; Immune electricity, fire, plant traits; SR 21; Weaknesses vulnerable to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +18 (1d8+6 B&P&S plus 1d6 fire), 2 claws +17 (1d6+6 B&S plus 1d6 fire)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon, fiery stride

STATISTICS

Str 22 (+6); Dex 14 (+2); Con 18 (+4); Int 11 (+0); Wis 16 (+3); Cha 13 (+1)
Base Atk +11; CMB +18; CMD 31
Feats Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Perception +22, Survival +13
Languages Ignan, Sylvan
SQ solar empathy +11

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Breath Weapon (Ex)

Once every 1d4 rounds, a sun sentinel can exhale a 60-ft. line of plasma as a standard action, which deals 10d6 fire and electricity damage (DC 19 half). The DC is Constitution-based.

Fiery Aura (Su)

Any creature that begins its turn adjacent to a sun sentinel, or passes through a square adjacent to a sun sentinel, takes 1d6 fire damage due to the intense heat radiating from the creature’s body. Likewise, if the sun sentinel passes through a square adjacent to a creature or unattended object, that creature or object takes 1d6 fire damage. A creature or object only takes this damage once per turn regardless of the number of adjacent squares passed through.

Solar Adaptation (Ex)

Often encountered in deserts, savannas, or on the Elemental Planes of Fire, sun sentinels are actually native to the surface of yellow suns. They can survive without water, air, or food, living entirely on the energy provided by the sun or other sources of fire.

Solar Empathy (Ex)

This ability functions as a druid’s wild empathy ability but only targets creatures with the fire subtype. A sun sentinel can use solar empathy to influence a creature of the outsider, plant, or vermin type with an Intelligence score of 1 or 2 just as they would a magical beast, provided the creature in question has the fire subtype.

ECOLOGY

Environment Any hot
Organization solitary, pair, or garden (3–8)
Treasure incidental

The lumbering creature that approaches you looks like a giant sunflower with a semi-humanoid body. In the center of its great flowery head is a gaping maw full of sharp, thorny teeth. Long, woody claws tip the end of the two arms that grow out of its thick, green stem above two stubby legs. Heat visibly shimmers in the air all around the creature.

Sun sentinels grow naturally on the surface of stars, especially in the cooler (“sunspot”) regions of medium-sized yellow suns. They see themselves as guardians of the other natural flora and fauna of those ecosystems.

While not overly aggressive, they will vigorously defend their territory, and prefer to act first and ask questions later.

Sun sentinels are long-lived but have short memories, relying on instinct and repetitive storytelling to reinforce their collective narrative. They rarely come into conflict with established humanoid settlements, but will readily attack travelers who stray from established paths or who harm the natural features or wildlife of their territory.
